entries.en: to snatch; to seize by force
entries.notes: L「arrebarar」与下文 por fuerza、alçarse con lo ajeno 诸条互见，当为 arrebatar（抢夺）之异写，H 仅「強」一字，故降为 medium。

entries.en: to snatch with an effort; to force against resistance
entries.notes: H「強逆」取违逆义，L「haciendo fuerza」谓使力，二栏合为「使力硬来」，惟与单纯「夺取」微有出入。

entries.zh: 强抢；以强力夺取（衣物等）
entries.en: to rob; to seize (clothing) by force
to rob; to make off with another's goods
entries.notes: H 第二字[疑:劫]；L「alçarse con lo ajeno」正谓取人财物，故定「劫」义。

entries.en: to strip off by force; to plunder
to occupy by force; to seize for oneself
entries.notes: H 第二字[疑:亡]；然 R「chièn」与 L「por fuerza」并指占据，取「占」义。

entries.zh: 强取（原文残缺，具体动作存疑）
entries.en: to snatch by force (text defective; exact action uncertain)
entries.notes: L「con el fuess que vtumpa」漫漶不成句，H 首字[疑:棚]、M「sá lià」未详，仅可定其属强取一类。

entries.en: to snatch with the hand; to grab
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:棚]、M「sá lag」未详；L「con la mano」明指以手取，姑定此义。

entries.en: to part or pry open with the hands
entries.notes: L 栏有[残]；H「開去」与 M「cûy cù」相合，故取分开义，余不可考。

entries.en: to carry away; to move off (the other part)
entries.notes: H「搬[疑:椴]走」，M「pūa châu」即搬走，与 L「llevar la otra parte」相合。

entries.en: rosy clouds; the red glow of clouds
clouds and rosy sky
the colour of the clouds
purple clouds
to become erect; to be sexually aroused
entries.notes: L「Arrechar」17 世纪义为动情、勃起，H「興陽」正谓振举阳气，二栏相合而义涉专门，故降为 medium。

entries.en: to tuck up; to gather up (garments)
entries.notes: L「Arre çar çara. g. naxoçlaro」漫漶，赖 H「攝」及下条「攝起」定其义。

entries.zh: 摄起；卷起、提起（衣袖、裤脚）
entries.en: to tuck up; to roll up (sleeves or trousers)
to tuck up a woman's clothing
entries.notes: L「a la omger」即 a la muger；H 第二字「陰」[疑:扱] 疑指下身，猥亵义未敢遽定。

entries.en: to lease; to rent (out)
connected; in a row; successive
entries.notes: H/M/R 三栏并为「連」，义尚可定；L「Arrexo. g. venglera」辨读未明，故降为 low。
